children: Some departing flights at airports across Britain were disrupted on Tuesday after air traffic control provider NATS experienced a technical issue, Heathrow Airport said, adding that arriving flights were not currently affected.
Heathrow said it was working with NATS to resolve the problem as quickly as possible.
